articles.title: Is the Stock Market Open Today? Here Are the Trading Hours for Easter Monday.
articles.mainIdea: Is the Stock Market Open Today? Here Are the Trading Hours for Easter Monday.
articles.summary: Barrons.com: Is the Stock Market Open Today? Here Are the Trading Hours for Easter Monday.. Here’s what to know about trading hours for Easter Monday. The New York Stock Exchange and the Nasdaq Stock Market will open at their regular time, 9:30 a.m. Eastern. Similarly, over-the-counter markets, the Cboe Futures Exchange, the CME Globex trading platform, and the bond market will be open at their regular hours. Related tickers mentioned: CBOE, COF-PK, COF-PL, COF-PN, JPM, UPS, WFC.
